sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which garden tool is primarily used for turning over soil, digging trenches, and breaking up hard dirt in a School Kitchen Garden?
A __________ is a simple machine consisting of a rigid bar resting on a pivot, used to help lift heavy loads with less effort.
What is the primary organic material you should collect in a compost pit to enrich the soil for your kitchen garden?
options: C) Dry leaves and vegetable peels
questions.answer: C) Dry leaves and vegetable peels

questions.question_text: When creating a Biodiversity Register, which of the following is NOT typically recorded?
options: C) The price of school textbooks
D) Insects found in the playground
questions.answer: C) The price of school textbooks

questions.question_text: A __________ is a simple machine made of a grooved wheel with a rope around it, commonly used to draw water from a well.

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the primary purpose of maintaining a school 'Biodiversity Register'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A biodiversity register records, tracks, and documents local varieties of plants, insects, and animals within the school compound to help students appreciate and protect native ecological treasures.

questions.question_text: Explain why weeding is an important maintenance task in a school kitchen garden. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Weeding removes unwanted wild plants that compete with cultivated vegetables for essential sunlight, water, and soil nutrients, ensuring the main crops grow healthy and strong.

questions.question_text: What is an 'Inclined Plane' in the context of simple machines? Give one daily life example. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An inclined plane is a flat supporting surface tilted at an angle, making it easier to move heavy loads upward. A common daily life example is a wheelchair ramp.

questions.question_text: Imagine your class is building a small working model of a well to demonstrate simple machines. Detail the materials you would need and how you would arrange the pulley mechanism to lift a tiny water bucket. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would use cardboard for the well structure, a plastic bottle cap with a groove as the wheel, a thin wooden stick for the axle, and strong thread as the rope. I would attach the wheel to the top stick, loop the thread over it, and tie a small paper cup bucket to one end.
